records.subject: Welcome aboard, Union Media
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

Glad to have Union Media on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Union Media* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Admin is engaged and replied positively on day 5 saying the project is "starting to click" [email:9e6508b9], and first_project was reached day 4, so momentum exists. But no invite sent, Starter plan solo use, and no tickets/questions; 8 days remain. Roughly even odds unaided.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield — how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Great to hear the first project is clicking — that's usually the point where the rest of Wrenfield falls into place. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so building that one out with your real work is exactly the right move.

Whenever you're ready to bring the rest of the Union Media team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Happy to walk through that first round of invites with you on a short call this week — just say when.

Best,
Nadia
